subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.------VT.DY.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-22, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the universal actualness of creativity is a factor that must be dealt with if we are to truly understand this consideration' and that 'we are left with no awareness about the composite thrust of world creativity — and this is unfortunate.' (C)RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is crossed with VT-DY (vibrational dynamics): the question is what reality alignment looks like when crossed with vibrational dynamics from the universal-philosophical perspective (rather than the cultural-particular perspective of v1-p377's NYM-11 reading). Three upstream feeds converge on RT-ALGN: PHY-U-C (physical universe context), PROG-SIGN (progressional significance), and RT-IMP (reality implications), with RT-IMP also feeding VT-DY directly. RT-ALGN outputs to LANG-DY (language dynamics), TRS (transition), SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), and POL-DYM (political dynamics). POL-DYM solid-links to IST-PT (isolated particulars); SOC-RT-DY solid-links to INFO-OR (information order); PROG-SIGN also bears on T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). Structural argument: reality alignment crossed with vibrational dynamics fans into four parallel cultural-political channels (language, transition, social-reality, political-dynamics), each terminating at its own structural element. The diagram makes Braxton's universal-philosophical claim structural: reality alignment as a vibrational phenomenon does not have a privileged single output — it constitutes the cultural-political field in its entirety.
